place one-third of the cheese in a single layer on the meat.
cover the grill and cook until the cheese melts, about 1 minute.
using the spatula, transfer the meat, cheese and vegetables to 2 of the rolls, dividing evenly.
wrap the sandwiches in aluminum foil.
repeat to make the remaining sandwiches.
serve warm.

title: Ginger Pear Crisp
directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees.
toss first six ingredients together in a bowl.
pour into a buttered baking dish.
using a fork combine the remaining six ingredients.
spoon topping across pears.
bake for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

title: Beef Stew
directions: heat drippings in 2-quart utility dish with microwave 20 to 30 seconds.
add onion.
cook 3 minutes or until onion is limp.
add remaining ingredients.
combine thoroughly.
cover and cook 8 minutes.
sprinkle with paprika before serving.
recipe yields 4 servings.

title: Tomato Wine
directions: mix fruits and boiling water.
when cool, add yeast.
stir every so often for about 10 days, then let stand for at least 2 months before straining.
use plastic waste can, cover and strain through old (boiled) hose or cheesecloth.

title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: mix cornflake crumbs with melted margarine.
spread half of the crumb mixture over bottom of casserole dish.
mix together cabbage and onion; spread over crumbs.
combine mayonnaise, milk, soup, salt and pepper.
pour over cabbage.
sprinkle dish with remaining crumbs.
cover crumbs with grated cheese.
bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 (small 3 oz.) pkg. lemon instant pudding mix
directions: preheat oven to 350°.
grease and flour 2 bread tins. mix all ingredients in bowl on medium for 2 minutes.
pour into tins. bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until tops are light brown.
cool for 10 minutes, then remove from tins.

title: Banana Cake
directions: grease and lightly flour 2 round baking pans.
in a mixer bowl combine the first 5 ingredients.
add shortening and banana; beat on low speed of electric mixer until combined.
add buttermilk or sour milk, eggs, and vanilla; beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. turn batter into prepared pans.
bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes or until done.
cool for 10 minutes on wire racks.
remove from pans; cool thoroughly.
frost with creamy butter frosting.

title: Italian Chicken Rollatini
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves pounded 1/4 inch thick,about 1-1/4 lbs.)
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese about 4 oz
1 jar bertolli vineyard premium collect marinara with burgundi wine sauc
8 ounces linguine or spaghetti, cooked and drained
directions: evenly top each chicken breast half with cheese and bacon. roll up and secure with wooden toothpicks. dip chicken in egg, then bread crumbs.

heat olive oil in 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat and brown chicken, turning occasionally. stir in sauce and broth. bring to a boil over high heat. reduce heat to low and simmer covered 10 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked.
to serve, arrange sauce and chicken over hot linguine. garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh basil or parsley.

title: Turkey Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 small potatoes, cooked and cut up
directions: saute onion and celery in 3 tbsp butter in large skillet until translucent.
add mixed vegetables, potatoes and chicken broth.
simmer for a few minutes, until frozen veg.
are thawed.
in the meantime, melt 3 tbsp butter in small pan, add flour, whisk until smooth.
add milk and stir until thick.
add to vegetable mixture-stir until blended-add turkey and cook until it thickens.
pour into unbaked pie shell-add top crust, pinch edges and make 4 slits in top of crust.
bake at 425f for 15 minutes; reduce heat to 325 and cook for another 20-30 minutes until crust is golden brown.

title: Escarole Soup With Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 7 1/2 cups canned low-sodium chicken broth or homemade stock
3/4 pound escarole (1 small head), leaves washed and cut into 1/2-inch ribbons
1 1/3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 4 in all), cut into 1/2-inch dice
directions: in a large pot, heat the oil over moderately low heat. add the carrot, onion, celery, and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables start to soften, about 5 minutes. add the broth, rice, and salt. bring to a boil. reduce the heat and simmer, partially covered, for 10 minutes.

add the escarole to the pot. bring to a simmer and cook until the escarole is almost tender, about 5 minutes. add the chicken and pepper. bring to a simmer and continue simmering for just 1 minute. the chicken should be done.
remove the pot from the heat. stir in the parsley and parmesan.
variation: for a richer soup, stir two well-beaten eggs into the pot along with the parsley and parmesan cheese (after removing the pot from the heat).
wine recommendation: avoid a red wine--its tannins will accentuate the bitterness of the greens. instead, try a rich tocai friulano, the nuttiness of which will complement the escarole.

title: Dad'S Breakfast Egg Muffins
directions: pre heat oven to 400 degrees.
in a large bowl mix cheese, veggies, eggs and meat. mix with a hand mixer until frothy.
add spices, continue to mix.
fold in bread.
spoon mixture into greased muffin pan.
cook for 20 min and enjoy.

title: Braised String Beans (Fassoulakia Yahni) Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 x fresh tomato peeled and minced
1 lb string beans parsley or possibly mint, minced salt and pepper water
directions: saute/fry onion and garlic in extra virgin olive oil till soft.
add in tomato paste and fresh tomato and simmer till sauce is slightly thickened.
add in string beans and seasoning and sufficient water to cover.
cover and cook till beans are tender.
makes 4-6 servings.
church

title: Easy Shrimp Appetizer
directions: all you have to do is place the bar of cream cheese on a nice dish, pour the cocktail sauce over it and top it off with the salad shrimp.
serve with your favorite crackers, most prefer triscuits or wheat thins. just dip crackers in and eat!
ps: size of items depends on how many your serving, so adjust as needed.

title: Vegetarian Croissant Sandwich
ingredients: 1 slice swiss cheese, cut in half diagonally
2 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 tablespoons salad dressing
4 slices thin zucchini or 4 slices cucumbers
1/2 1 dash dried dill or 1 dash basil, crushed
mixed sprouts, of your choice if desired
directions: if desired, wrap croissant in foil and heat in a 350°f oven about 4 minutes or just until warm.
split croissant, then spread lightly with mustard.
arrange lettuce leaf, swiss cheese, tomato slices, avocado, zucchini or cucumber, and mushroom slices on bottom half of croissant.
combine mayonnaise, milk, and dill weed or basil.
add sprouts if desired.
spoon over filling.
add top half of croissant.
makes 1 serving.
tip: you may substitute any of your favorite fresh vegetables for the tomato, zucchini, cucumber, or mushroom.
some vegetables, such as green beans, thinly sliced carrots, or asparagus, are especially good when steamed for a few minutes and then marinated for several hours in a vinaigrette dressing.
enjoy!

title: Pineapple Eggnog Punch Recipe
ingredients: lime or possibly pineapple sherbet, cut in pcs
directions: in punch bowl combine cool eggnog, pineapple juice and ginger ale.
float sherbet pcs on top.
serve immediately.
maraschino cherries added to punch give a very colorful effect.
makes 1 gallon.

title: Hidden Valley Crackers
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) box sunshine oyster or soup crackers
directions: mix wesson oil, hidden valley dressing mix, lemon-pepper, garlic salt or powder and dill weed.
pour over oyster or soup crackers.
set aside overnight.
keep in ziploc bag.

title: Evelyn'S Turkey Marinade
directions: marinate turkey breast cutlets in mixture for 24 hours. grill.

title: Hands Off My Beef Stroganoff
directions: marinade beef cubes overnight
remove beef cubes from marinade, set marinade to the side
brown beef cubes on all sides, set to the side
in same pan, sautee onions and garlic, until onions are transluscent
place browned beef back into pan
add marinade
add red wine
simmer for 45 minutes to an hour, or until beef has reached desired tenderness
add sour cream and cream of mushroom soup to beef mixture five to ten minutes before serving.
boil egg noodles according to package, drain
serve over egg noodles.

title: Slow-Cooked Sausage Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/4 inch slices
1 1/2 cups uncooked uncle ben converted rice
directions: add all ingredients to a slow cooker; stir to mix.
cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until rice is tender.

title: Marbled Bread
ingredients: 1 beaten egg, will also be needed for brushing the bread dough later
directions: the two loaves are prepared separately.
for each: stir together 1 c flour, all the water@ 126f, and all the yeast.
allow to rise for 1 hour.
add the remaining ingredients and knead by machine for two minutes.
to assemble: pat the white dough portion into a rectangle about 10" by 12".
brush with beaten egg.
pat the wheat dough portion into a rectangle of the same size.
place on top of the white bread dough.
brush wheat dough with beaten egg.
roll up and pinch seams closed.
place dough in a lightly greased bread pan, seam facing down.
allow to rise for 1 hour or until the dough has doubled and crowed 1 inch above the side of the pan.
bake 32-36 minutes at 400f.
the internal bread temperature should be 190f when the bread is finished.
allow bread to cool for a few minutes before removing from the pan.
this makes a large loaf, could possibly make two smaller loaves.

title: Simply Salad(2 Servings)
ingredients: 1/4 c. parmesan cheese (fresh grated is best)
directions: tear lettuce into bowl (may use other types in combination with iceberg).
add tomato, scallions and avocado (may stop at this point and refrigerate).
just before serving, add olive oil, garlic salt, squeezed lemon and parmesan cheese.
toss and serve right away.
(the garlic salt wilts the lettuce fast!)

title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) bottle kraft zesty italian dressing
directions: cook pasta as directed.
rinse in cold water and drain well. put in serving bowl and add remaining ingredients.
mix well. refrigerate several hours or overnight.

title: Peanut Butter Bonbons
directions: combine butter, peanut butter and confectioners sugar.
mix well.
add rice krispies and walnuts.
chill.
shape into 1-inch balls.
chill.
dip in chocolate.
melt chocolate bits and chocolate bar.
dip balls into this using a fork to cover and remove to cookie sheet.
chill.

title: Creamy Broccoli Casserole
directions: place 1-inch of water and broccoli in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 to 8 minutes or until crisp-tender.

title: Raspberry-Chipotle Pulled Pork Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 cup raspberry-chipotle bbq sauce (i used fischer & wieser brand)
4 cups pulled pork (there's a cheater version in my recipe box)
directions: note: if you cant find maggi seasoning, just use a dash each of worcestershire sauce and soy sauce.
for the slaw:
combine all of the slaw ingredients, except the slaw mix, in a large mixing bowl and whisk until all of the dressing ingredients are smooth and well-incorporated.
add the slaw and fold it in so that its evenly coated.
cover and refrigerate 2-4 hours, stirring occasionally.
for the sandwiches:
warm the sauce and buns.
top each bun with 1/2 cup of pork (hot, of course), 2 tablespoons of sauce, and 1/4 cup of slaw (drained of excess juice).
tip: i press the slaw in a pasta fork to remove the juice.
serve and enjoy!

title: Frozen Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can whole berry cranberry sauce
directions: dissolve jell-o in hot water.
add raspberries and stir until berries separate.
cream the cream cheese and gradually blend in sour cream and cranberry sauce.
stir gelatin mixture in gently and add dash of salt.
freeze in glass dish until firm.
cut into squares and serve with or without extra sour cream.

title: Pasta With Marinara Sauce And Ricotta
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: dried basil and oregano
directions: saute garlic in oil.
add tomatoes and seasonings.
simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
pour over pasta.
stir in ricotta cheese.
you may substitute 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella for the ricotta cheese.

title: Sesame Pesto
ingredients: 2 cups fresh cilantro, packed (or 1 cup cilantro and 1 cup parsley)
2 teaspoons lemon juice or 2 teaspoons lime juice
directions: toast the sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until lightly browned and subtley fragrant. watch pan carefully because sesame seeds burn easily.
set aside to cool.
once cooled, place sesame seeds in a blender or food processor and blend until coarsely ground, about 30 seconds total.
add the cilantro, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper. blend mixture using the pulse button setting.
with machine running, {{gradually}} add the olive oil in a steady, slow stream and process mixture until smooth.
store in covered container in refrigerator. use up within 1 month. bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Chocolate Toffee Cake
ingredients: 1 package (8 ounces) milk chocolate english toffee bits
directions: combine the toffee bits, chips and brown sugar; set aside.

in a large bowl, cream butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition (mixture will appear curdled). beat in vanilla. combine the flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda; add to the creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beating well after each addition.

pour a third of the batter into a greased and floured 10-in. fluted tube pan. sprinkle with a third of the toffee mixture. repeat layers twice. bake at 350° for 55-65 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to wire rack to cool completely. for icing, in a small saucepan, melt butter. stir in flour until smooth; gradually add evaporated milk and brown sugar. bring to a boil; cook and stir for 4-5 minutes or until thickened. cool. drizzle over cake.

title: Pulled Pork Tostadas With Slaw And Chipotle Cream
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/4 pounds chili rub slow cooker pulled pork, warm or room temperature
2 tablespoons canola oil or other neutral-flavored oil
8 cups finely shredded cabbage or 1 10-ounce bag finely shredded cabbage or slaw mix
1/2 chipotle pepper from a can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, seeded and finely minced
directions: halve and squeeze 1 or 2 of the limes to yield 2 tablespoons of juice. in a large bowl, combine the lime juice and oil. add the cabbage, onion, and cilantro, tossing to combine. add salt to taste. cut the remaining 2 limes into 6 wedges each. set the slaw and lime wedges aside.
in a small bowl, combine the sour cream and chipotle. season with salt and set aside.
arrange the tortillas on plates. top with the pork, slaw, sour cream mixture, and tomatoes. arrange the lime and radish wedges alongside and serve.
serving suggestions

if you like, you can use regular tortillas, warmed up, instead of the crisped ones, to make soft tacos instead of tostadas. and you can experiment with the slaw to make it your own - try adding shredded zucchini, thinly sliced bell pepper, or diced cucumber.
nutrition per serving
calories: 350
fat: 12g	 saturated fat: 2.5g
cholesterol: 50mg
sodium: 380mg
carbohydrate: 39g
protein:22g
fiber: 6g

title: Georgia Sausage W/ Sweet Potatoes
directions: boil sweet potatoes in their skins.
peel and cut into strips lengthwise and put in bottom of casserole.
brown sausage on both sides in frying pan; place over potatoes and cover with sliced apples.
mix sausage fat, hot water, brown sugar, and worcestershire sauce; pour over all.
bake at 350* for 40 minutes.
keep covered until last 10 minutes.

title: Pork Chops In Creamy Mustard Sauce
directions: preheat oven to 380
brown chops in pan quickly, just for crust. set aside.
saute onions in pan. add cream, sour cream, mustard to color, salt, and pepper to taste. let cook under medium low heat for 2-3 minutes.
place layer of sauce on bottom of pyrex dish, followed by layer of chops, repeat until full. cover with aluminum foil and cook for 20-25 minutes or until pork is done and the juices mingle.

title: Brussels Sprouts With Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 pinch ground nutmeg, or to taste
directions: place brussels sprouts into a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. cook until tender yet firm to the bite, about 15 minutes. drain.

melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat while brussels sprouts are cooking and cook onion until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. pour in white wine and bring to a boil. stir in cream, nutmeg, and pepper. add edam cheese and stir until melted. add drained brussels sprouts and heat in cheese sauce over low heat, about 5 minutes. season with salt.

title: Melina'S Southwest Skillet Supperserves 4
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, cut in strips
directions: saute onion and garlic in margarine.
add remaining ingredients and cook over medium-high heat, stirring frequently until vegetables are crisp-tender and most liquid has evaporated, about 3-4 minutes.

title: Ukrainian Cream Of Wheat Fritters (Slast'Ony Z Manykh Krupiv)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar (or 2 tablespoons sugar with 1/2 teaspoon vanilla flavoring)
whipped cream (or half whipped cream and half sour cream)
directions: heat 1 cup milk to boiling and add cream of wheat while stirring. simmer until thickened, then cover and cook for 5 minutes. cool. in a bowl, combine porridge with salt, baking powder, and 1/2 cup milk and stir.
separate eggs. beat yolks with vanilla sugar until well mixed. add melted butter and mix with porridge. whip egg whites until stiff and fold into batter.
in a large skillet, drop batter by spoonfuls into hot butter, turning to cook both sides. keep cakes warm in oven.
serve with whipped cream and cherry syrup for breakfast or a light luncheon or supper. makes about 8 cakes.
festive ukrainian cooking.

title: Potato Burger Pie
ingredients: 1 partially baked 9-inch deep dish pie shell
directions: brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain.
add eggs, potato, tomato sauce, cheese, worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, salt and pepper; mix well. spoon into pie shell.
bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
yield:
6 servings.

title: Coconut Pie
directions: cream the butter and sugar. add rest of ingredients in the order given.
pour in pie shell. bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

title: Pecan Squash
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) pkg. squash or 24 oz. cooked squash
directions: combine first 6 ingredients and pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
combine nuts and syrup and pour over squash.
bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

title: Beer & Honey Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 (15 1/2 ounce) cans white kidney beans, rinsed and drained (cannelini)
directions: cook bacon till crisp and crumble (set aside).
add onion to the bacon drippings and cook till golden brown (about 6 minutes).
stir in beer, catsup, honey and brown mustard.
cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
stir in the beans and reserved bacon, bring to a simmer.
cover and bake for 1 hour.
uncover and continue baking until the beans have absorbed most of the liquid and look glazed, about 30 minutes.
serve hot.

title: Pasta alla Vodka with Sausage
ingredients: 1 jar premade vodka sauce (24 ounce jar)
1 can (14 oz. size) italian diced tomatoes
2 cups grated parmesan or mozzarella cheese
directions: prepare 1 pound of pasta al dente.
return the pasta to its original pot after draining.
heat a large wok or saute pan to medium-high heat.
sprinkle salt and black pepper into the hot pan.
slice down the length of 3 large links of hot italian sausage.
remove the sausage meat from the casings and put the meat directly into the hot pan.
crumble/chop the sausage as it browns in the pan.
as soon as the sausage is cooked through, turn the burner down to medium heat and add 1 jar of pre-made vodka sauce immediately into the pan.
stir well.
add 1 can italian diced tomatoes to the sauce.
do not drain tomatoes before adding to sauce.
stir.
add 3 tablespoons heavy cream to sauce and stir.
add all spices, including hot sauce (around 4-6 dashes for a mild sauce, more for a spicier sauce.
the sausage is made with red pepper flakes and can add significant spice to the sauce, so taste the sauce after the first few dashes of hot sauce).
when ingredients are combined, pour contents of wok or saute pan into the pasta pot.
stir to combine.
immediately after the sauce and pasta are combined, add 2 cups cheese to pot and stir well.
serve.

title: Chicken Salad With Pecans
directions: sprinkle chicken breasts lightly with lemon pepper and garlic salt.
saute until juices run clear and chicken is cooked through.
cool chicken, then chop into bite size pieces.
mix in celery, onion, pecans, mayonnaise, lemon juice and sugar.
chill.
serve on lettuce leaves as a salad or as a sandwich filling.

title: Peach perfect smoothie
directions: blend all together in blender for about 3 minutes or until smooth, that easy

title: Coconut Sour Cream Dream Cake
ingredients: 1 (18 1/2 oz.) pkg. butter flavor cake mix
1 (12 oz.) pkg. very fine frozen coconut, thawed
1 1/2 c. whipping cream or thawed cool whip
directions: prepare cake according to directions, making two 8-inch layers. split both layers (when cool) horizontally.
blend together the sugar, sour cream and coconut; chill.
spread all but 1 cup of the sour cream mixture between the four layers.
blend the remaining sour cream with whipped cream and spread on top and sides of cake. seal in an airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving.
keep refrigerated after cutting.

title: Orange Cranberry Bread
directions: sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
stir in cranberries, nuts and orange peel.
in another bowl, combine egg, orange juice and oil; add to flour mixture.
stir until just moistened; do not overstir.
pour into a greased and floured 9-inch loaf pan.
bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

title: Tapenade Twists
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped anchovies or 1/2 teaspoon anchovy paste
directions: process first 5 ingredients in a food processor until smooth. unfold pastry sheet onto a lightly floured surface. roll into a 12- x 10-inch rectangle.

spread olive mixture onto lengthwise half of rectangle to within 1 inch of long edge; fold pastry over filling. roll gently with a rolling pin; pinch edges to seal. cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips. twist strips; place on a greased baking sheet.
bake at 400° for 15 minutes. place onto wire racks to cool.

title: Grilled Fruit Sundaes
ingredients: 3 cups cut-up fruit (pineapple, strawberries, kiwi, peaches, banana, apple)
12 small scoop vanilla or 12 small cherry vanilla ice cream
directions: combine in a small sauce pan the orange juice, honey and lemon juice to a boil over high heat, stirring frequently.
reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes or until slighty thickened.
remove from heat and cool to room temperature.
alternately thread fruit on skewers.
grill kabobs, turning once and brushing with 1/2 of the orange syrup, 4 minutes or until softened.
note: if using wooden skewers soak at least 30 minutes prior to use.

title: Chicken Stuffing Casserole
directions: boil breasts until tender.
remove meat and cut into bite size pieces.
mix soup and sour cream.
mix into chicken.
make stove top mix as directed.
drop stuffing onto chicken mixture.
spread evenly.
cover and bake 350° for 1 hour.

title: North African Salad *ari*/Sig
ingredients: 1 handful of pitted black best olives
1 bunch of watercress or wild rocket
directions: slice the oranges across into thin rounds and spread over serving dish.
sprinkle over the onion slices and olives.arrange watercress around platter.
add an yoghurt or mint dressing if you desire.
sprinkle with paprika and serve
onions helps counter blood clotting.
tendency after eating fatty food.
watercress is rich in folate, vitamin c and iron.
oranges are also rich in vitamin c. this salad is good with respiratory infection and helps bodies defences.

title: Crock-Pot Chicken In Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
1 cup chablis or 1 cup other dry white wine
1/4 cup coarsely chopped pitted kalamata olives or 1/4 cup oil-cured olives
1 (14 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 cup drained and coarsely chopped sun-dried tomato
8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (about 2 pounds)
directions: stir the soup, wine, olives, capers, garlic, artichokes and tomatoes in a 3 1/2-quart slow cooker. add the chicken and turn to coat.
cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours** or until the chicken is cooked through. sprinkle with the basil, if desired. serve with the rice.

title: Banana Graham Dessert Recipe
ingredients: 1 sm instant sugar-free vanilla pudding mix
directions: in a mixing bowl, beat pudding mix and lowfat milk on low speed for 2 min.
mix in lowfat sour cream.
let stand for 5 min.
in a 3-quart.
bowl, layer a third of the gra ham crackers, bananas and pudding mix ture.
repeat layers twice.
chill.

title: Blueberry Cobbler
directions: preheat oven to 350°. place butter in an 8-inch square metal baking pan; place pan in oven 3 minutes or until butter melts.

while butter melts, weigh or lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife. combine flour, 6 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, and salt in medium bowl; stir with a whisk until blended. combine milk, lemon rind, and vanilla; add to flour mixture, stirring with a whisk just until moist.

pour batter over melted butter in pan (do not stir); top with blueberries. sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons sugar. bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly and crust is lightly browned. serve with ice cream.

title: Veggie Meatloaf with Mushrooms and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup breadcrumbs, plus more for coating ramekins
1 pound mix of portobello and cremini mushrooms, trimmed and finely chopped in a food processor
kosher salt and freshly ground pepper
8 ounces baby spinach leaves, for serving
directions: preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. butter 4 (8-ounce) ramekins and lightly coat with breadcrumbs.
soak the sun-dried tomatoes in the water until soft.
remove the tomatoes and coarsely chop.
in a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and soaking water, and add the breadcrumbs.
set aside.
heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the olive oil, followed by the onions.
cook until brown, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes.
add the garlic, mushrooms, and sun-dried tomatoes and cook until the liquid from the mushrooms has evaporated, about 15 minutes.
stir in 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 1 teaspoon pepper.
transfer the vegetables to a large bowl to cool.
add the breadcrumb mixture and the grated cheese to the vegetables and mix well with your hands.
evenly distribute the mixture among the coated ramekins.
place on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
let cool slightly, then run a knife around the edges of the ramekins.
toss the spinach in a hot skillet just until wilted and divide among 4 serving plates.
invert the meatloaf onto the spinach.
serve immediately.

title: Devil Dogs Ii
directions: sift dry ingredients and remaining ingredients.
mix until smooth.
drop by teaspoon on lightly greased cookie sheet.
bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
cool.

title: Corn Flake Pudding
directions: mix thoroughly and pour into a lightly greased pan.
bake at 350° for 1 hour.
tastes like indian pudding.

title: Greek Feta Salad
ingredients: 3 tomatoes (1 lb./450 g), seeded, chopped safeway 1 lb for $1.29 thru 02/09
1/3 cup kraft extra virgin olive oil greek feta dressing
1/2 cup crumbled cracker barrel crumbled feta cheese with oregano, sun dried tomatoes and black pepper
directions: combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
add dressing; mix lightly.
top with olives and cheese.

title: Mojito Martini
ingredients: 34 ounce simple syrup (1 part water, 1 part sugar)
directions: in a mixing glass, mash/muddle together the lime wedges, mint leaves, and simple syrup until the mint leaves are fairly crushed and most of the lime juice has been extracted from the lime.
add in ice and the barcardi limon; cover and shake vigorously.
strain loosely into a martini glass.
top off with soda water; garnish with a mint sprig.

title: Zesty Potato Topping for Focaccia
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced very thin
directions: mix all ingredients together.
once focaccia has been prepared and placed in tin, place mixture on the top.
allow to rise again for approximately 20 - 30 minutes.
bake.

title: American Moussaka
ingredients: 1 pkg. hamburger helper mix (for potato stroganoff)
directions: heat oven to 375°.
cook and stir ground beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown; drain.
stir in tomato sauce, salt, oregano, cinnamon and garlic powder.
grease baking dish 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch.
layer half each of the potatoes, beef mixture and cheese in dish; repeat.
mix sauce mix, milk and water; stir in eggs gradually.
pour milk-egg mixture over cheese and sprinkle with paprika.
cover and bake 50 minutes.
uncover and bake 10 minutes.
let stand 10 minutes before serving.
makes about 6 servings.

title: Sparkling Holiday Punch
ingredients: 10 small cinnamon sticks, plus more for garnish
1 bottle (750 ml) chilled sparkling pear cider
1 bottle (750 ml) chilled sparkling apple cider
apple and pear slices and freshly grated nutmeg, for garnish
directions: in a large saucepan, combine the apple cider, brown sugar, cloves, 10 cinnamon sticks, allspice, cardamom and nutmeg and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
let cool, then strain the mulled cider into a jar, cover and refrigerate until chilled, or up to 1 week.
pour the filtered water into a wide, shallow plastic container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
pour the mulled cider into a punch bowl and add the ice block.
stir in the sparkling pear and apple ciders, garnish with the apple and pear slices, cinnamon sticks and freshly grated nutmeg and serve in coupes or teacups.

title: Apple Raisin Bran Muffins (With Flax Seed)
directions: preheat oven to 350 f.
combine dry ingredients into large bowl.
combine wet ingredients into smaller bowl.
add wet ingredients to dry ingredients.
spoon into greased muffin tins up to the lip of the tin.
bake 15-30 minutes, depending on altitude (the higher the altitude, the longer you'll need to cook them).
to keep the ultimate amount of moisture while storing, place the muffins into a ziplock bag immediately after removing them from the oven (while still piping hot).
note: if you don't have flax seed, add another egg and don't add the 3 tablespoons of water.
note: the brown sugar can be substituted with the same amount of maple syrup.

title: Creamy Pineapple Salad Recipe
ingredients: 3 tbsp. miracle whip or possibly hellmann's mayonnaise
directions: heat pineapple and sugar to boil.
add in jello while hot.
let cold.
add in cheese, nuts and miracle whip (or possibly mayonnaise); blend well.
add in cold whip.
blend and refrigeratefor 3 hrs.

title: Raspberry-Rhubarb Crumble With Cracklin' Oat Bran Topping
ingredients: 420 grams rhubarb, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1/4 cup raw sugar, or more to taste
directions: preheat the oven to 350° f.
in a medium bowl, mix together the raspberries, rhubarb, sugar, and salt. if your raspberries are not sweet, you might consider adding another 2 tablespoons or 1/4 cup of sugar. set aside.

use a food processor to grind the cracklin' oat bran into a powder that resembles oat bran. in a medium bowl, mix this with the walnuts and pecans. using your fingers, work the butter into the dry ingredients until you have clumps.

dump the fruit into a 9- or 10-inch ovenproof skillet or baking dish. top with the cracklin' oat bran crumble. bake for 30 to 40 minutes, until the fruit is bubbling and the top is golden-brown and crisp.
serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Bouchon's Lemon Tart Recipe
ingredients: 1 c. unsalted butter - (2 sticks) room temperature
directions: for the pine nut crust: place the pine nuts in a food processor and pulse a few times.
add in the sugar and flour and continue to pulse till the nuts are finely grnd.
place the nut mix in a mixing bowl and add in the butter, egg and vanilla.
beat with an electric mixer or possibly by hand till thoroughly combined.
divide the dough into 3 parts.
wrap each piece in plastic wrap.
freeze 2 pcs for future use and chill the third piece for at least 10 min before using.
heat the oven to 350 degrees.
generously butter and flour a 9-inch fluted tart pan with a removable bottom and chill it while the oven heats.
remove the tart pan from the refrigerator and use your fingertips to press the chilled dough over the bottom and up the sides of the pan.
trim off excess.
bake the crust for 10 to 15 min, then rotate the shell and continue baking till golden, another 10 to 15 min.
remove the shell from the oven while you make the filling.
there may be some cracks in the shell.
they won't affect the tart.
for the lemon sabayon: bring about 1 1/2 inches of water to a boil in a pot which is slightly smaller than the diameter of the mixing bowl you will be using for the sabayon.
meanwhile, in a large metal bowl, whisk the large eggs, yolks and sugar till smooth, about 1 minute.
set the bowl over the pot so which it's not touching the water, and, using a large whisk, whip the mix while you turn the bowl, for even heating.
when the large eggs are foamy and have thickened, about 2 min, add in one-third of the lemon juice.
continue to whisk vigorously and when the mix thickens again, add in another third of the lemon juice.
whisk till the mix thickens again, then add in the remaining lemon juice.
continue whisking vigorously, still turning the bowl, till the mix is thickened and light in color, and the whisk leaves a trail at the bottom of the bowl.
the total cooking time should be about 8 to 10 min.
turn off the heat, but leave the bowl over the water as you add in the butter, whisking in, one tbsp.
at a time.
the sabayon may loosen slightly, but it will thicken and set as it cools.
pour into the tart shell and place on a baking sheet.
heat the broiler.
while the sabayon is still hot, place the tart under the broiler.
leaving the oven door open, brown the top of the sabayon, rotating the tart if necessary for even color, about 20 to 30 seconds.
keep an eye on the tart so it doesn't burn.
remove the tart from the oven and let it sit at least 1 hour before serving at room temperature or possibly chilled.
this recipe yields 8 servings.
comments:this recipe makes sufficient dough for three crusts and sufficient filling for one tart, so freeze the extra dough for the future.

title: Baked Cheese Omelet
directions: skin and slice tomatoes, cook in a little margarine in a saucepan, and then pour into a greased pie dish.
in the same pan, with a little more margarine, add the milk and the slightly beaten eggs.
cook over low heat, stirring as for scrambled eggs, until just beginning to set.

title: Spinach Salad
directions: place spinach in a large salad bowl.
add the shredded carrots.
slice mushrooms and add.
fry bacon; cool, crumble and add to vegetables.
add cherry tomatoes.
cover and refrigerate overnight.
add the wine vinegar before serving (use more or less than 3 tablespoons as desired).

title: Seven Layer Bars
directions: first layer must be melted margarine (melt margarine and let sit for 15 minutes).
then, add remaining ingredients layer after layer.
final layer must be condensed milk.
bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
put in refrigerator until chilled.

title: Wilted Lettuce
directions: combine cut-up lettuce, onion and salt in a bowl.
cut bacon into small pieces, fry until crisp; do not drain.
remove from heat and add vinegar, then sugar and mix well.
return to heat and slowly add beaten eggs, stirring constantly.
stir on heat until mixture thickens.
pour over lettuce while warm.
mix and serve while still warm.
serves 6 to 8.

title: Lentils with Garlic Sausage
ingredients: 1 pound french garlic sausage or kielbasa, cut into 3/4-inch pieces
2 leeks, white and tender green parts only, thinly sliced
3 thyme sprigs, 1 rosemary sprig and 1 fresh bay leaf, tied in a bundle
directions: in a large, heavy dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil.
add the garlic sausage and cook over moderately high heat, stirring, until browned, 5 minutes.
using a slotted spoon, transfer the sausage to a plate.
add the leeks, carrot and garlic to the dutch oven and cook over moderate heat until softened, about 7 minutes.
add the lentils, herb bundle and 5 cups of water and bring to a boil.
season with salt and simmer over low heat, until the lentils are tender, about 35 minutes.
discard the herb bundle.
meanwhile, preheat the oven to 350.
spread the hazelnuts in a pie plate and toast for about 12 minutes, until golden.
let cool, then transfer the nuts to a kitchen towel and rub off the skins.
coarsely chop the nuts.
in a small bowl, combine the mustard with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
add the escarole to the stew and cook until wilted, 6 minutes.
stir in the sausage and cook until hot.
transfer the stew to bowls and drizzle with the mustard oil.
garnish with the nuts and parsley and serve.

title: Pizza Hot Dish(Microwave)
ingredients: 1/2 c. sliced ripe or green olives (18)
directions: put onions and green pepper in 2-quart casserole.
crumble meat and cook on high, uncovered, until meat is set, stirring once. drain.
stir in remaining ingredients except cheeses and cover with casserole lid.
micro on high 15 to 17 minutes or until noodles are tender, stirring 2 to 3 times.
sprinkle with cheeses.
microwave on high uncovered 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until cheeses are melted.

title: Strawberries And Almond Cream
directions: carefully wash berries; drain on paper towels.
cut a deep "x" from pointed end of each berry to 1/4-inch from stem end.
gently spread apart to make petals.
set aside on a serving plate. prepare pudding according to package directions except use only 3/4 cup milk.
gently fold whipped cream and extract into pudding. pipe pudding mix into strawberries from a decorating bag with a large tip.
serve immediately.

title: Screwed Banana
directions: put ice in highball glass, about 1/2 full, then pour in the banana liqueur and the peach schnapps.
fill with orange juice.
stir.

title: Gina'S Lemon Pepper Chicken
directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f (175 degrees c).
place chicken in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. season with lemon pepper, garlic powder and onion powder to taste. bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes.
turn over chicken pieces and add more seasoning to taste. bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Golden Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. light cream or evaporated milk
directions: cook eggplant in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain. combine remaining ingredients.
turn into a 1-quart casserole. bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
good.

title: Grandma Houser'S Slaw
directions: grate cabbage, onion and carrots; mix together in a large bowl.
sprinkle with celery seed and sugar.
add vinegar and oil; mix thoroughly.
refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

title: Tiramisu Mini Muffins
ingredients: 1 (18 ounce) package butter pecan cake mix
5 teaspoons instant espresso powder (or instant flavored coffee)
directions: preheat oven 375°f.
in a bowl, beat the cake mix, eggs, milk and oil together. basically according to the box directions.
grease mini muffin tin and bake muffins for 5-7 minutes or until toothpick approved. cool, poke holes and air dry for 30 minutes. makes 48 mini muffins.
in another bowl, with hand mixer, add whipping cream liquid, vanilla, 1 tsp of instant espresso powder and icing sugar. whip until its light and fluffy, about 5 minutes.

in a small bowl, whip up the mascarpone cheese light and fluffy like. add a spoon full of cheese in the whipping cream. whip together until light and fluffy. then fold in the rest of the whipped cheese with a spatula in the whipping cream, blend.

add 4 tsp instant espresso or coffee in the warm water, mix. honestly test the flavor of it and make sure you like it cause the muffins get dipped in it. once espresso mixed, dip the top half of the muffin to absorb some of the espresso flavor.
top each muffin with tiramisu cream and sprinkle with coco or chocolate shavings. i grated 1/2 cup of chocolate chips and sprinkle some in espresso, little little bit. tossed and topped the muffins.

title: Night Before Coffeecake
directions: combine dry ingredients; set aside.
cream together in large bowl the margarine, sugar, eggs and brown sugar.
add dry ingredients to creamed, alternating with buttermilk.
beat until smooth.
add nuts and raisins.
pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish and sprinkle batter with following combined ingredients:
1/2 cup nuts, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon.
cover tightly; refrigerate overnight and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Strawberry Delight
directions: mix jello with hot water. add ice cream and stir until mixed. let cool until half jelled, then add remaining ingredients. chill.

title: Herb-Roasted Chicken-And-Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 pound dried cranberry beans or pinto beans
1 tablespoon chopped fresh or 1 teaspoon dried thyme, divided
directions: sort and wash beans, and place in a large dutch oven. cover with water to 2 inches above beans; bring to a boil, and cook 2 minutes. remove from heat; cover and let stand 1 hour. drain beans, and discard liquid. combine beans, 2 quarts water, 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, garlic halves, and 2 bay leaves in a dutch oven; bring to a boil. partially cover, reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour or until almost tender. drain bean mixture in a colander over a bowl, reserving 2 cups liquid. discard 2 bay leaves.
preheat oven to 350°.
sprinkle chicken with 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.

heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. add chicken; cook 4 minutes, browning on all sides. remove chicken from skillet. add 1 1/2 teaspoons thyme, carrot, onion, 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon, and minced garlic; saute 5 minutes or until tender.

layer half of beans in the bottom of the dutch oven. add the carrot mixture, chicken, and remaining beans. add the reserved 2 cups cooking liquid, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon pepper, and 2 bay leaves. cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken and beans are tender, spooning cooking liquid over beans occasionally. remove from oven; discard bay leaves.
preheat broiler.

combine 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/8 teaspoon cinnamon, chopped parsley, and breadcrumbs, and toss the parsley mixture well. sprinkle the parsley mixture over the chicken and beans. broil for 2 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned.
note: each serving provides 405 micrograms of folate.

title: Holiday Spaghetti
ingredients: hot drained, boiled spaghetti (8 oz. uncooked)
directions: heat oven to 350°.
fry bacon.
saute onion, green pepper and mushrooms in hot drippings until onion is yellow.
add ground chuck and cook until browned.
add rest of ingredients and heat. pour into well-greased 2-quart baking dish.
sprinkle with grated sharp cheese.
bake 30 minutes.
serve hot, garnished with crisp bacon and parsley.

title: Stuffed Chicken from Heaven
ingredients: 1 (11 1/2 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup (or chicken, broccoli, etc any cream soup will work)
14 lb pastrami (from deli works best but packaged is okay in a pinch)
14 lb corned beef (from deli works best but packaged is okay in a pinch)
12 ounces turkey bacon (you can use real bacon if you prefer but it will make the saucing greasier and not as thick)
directions: coat 9 1/2 x 13 baking pan (glass is best) with cooking spray.
measure out 4 slices of pastrami and 4 slices of corned beef.
cut each of these in half (for new total of 8 slices) and set aside.
line bottom of baking pan with remaining sliced meat.
mix sour cream and soup together.
slice cheese in about 1/4 inch slices.
(note, string cheese also works and saves on having to cut cheese).
place chicken on cutting board and put plastic wrap over top and then pound chicken flat.
(note; if you don't have a mallet, you can use a heavy pan.
cut each pounded chicken breasts into 2 pieces.
assembly:.
1 piece of chicken.
top with 1 piece of cut pastrami.
top with 1 piece of cut corned beef.
top with mozzarella cheese piece.
roll into a tight ball.
wrap each chicken roll with a slice of bacon and secure closed with a toothpick.
place rolls in baking dish on top of leftover deli meats.
repeat for remaining 7 pieces of chicken.
top with sour cream/soup mixture.
bake at 350f for 1 hour.
serve over egg noodles scooping up sauce mixture that will be formed as the sauce for the noodles.

title: Orange-Lemon Icing
directions: mix together until smooth and of spreading consistency.

title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: mix well the cracker crumbs and 1/2 cup butter.
line bottom of baking dish with 1 cup buttered crumbs.
add asparagus. sprinkle with almonds.
cover with cheese sauce made from remaining ingredients.
sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs over cheese sauce.
bake at 450° for 10 minutes or until brown.

title: Mini Frittatas With Tofu, Mushrooms and Asparagus
ingredients: 4 eggs, lightly beaten (i use vegetarian fed eggs)
4 slices bacon, sliced thinly (i use sanitarium vegetarian rashers)
2 tablespoons sambal oelek (i used chilli sauce with sugar)
directions: preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.
saute onions and garlic until caramelized.
add bacon until cooked.
add asparagus and cook till a little soft.
add mushrooms and tomatos at same time.
mix chilli sauce in and cook all vegetables are soft.
place eggs and tofu together and mix together.
add salt and vegetable mix, stir.
place in muffin pan that has been greased or lined with paper.
place in oven for 15 minutes.
turn heat up to 220 degrees celsius and leave in for another 10 minutes or until mixture is firm.

title: Easy 3-Ingredient White Chocolate Oreo Balls
directions: separate oreo cookies and remove the cream between the biscuits. crush biscuits coarsely.
transfer crushed oreos to a bowl. add condensed milk, just enough so that you can form balls with the mixture. shape small balls and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
meanwhile, melt the white chocolate on the stovetop using the double boiler method.

after 10 minutes, take out balls from refrigerator. take one ball and dip it into melted white chocolate. use a spoon to remove the ball from the chocolate and place it onto a tray. repeat with remaining oreo balls.
cool in the refrigerator for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Ripe Catsup
directions: cook down real low.
keep stirred so it won't stick.

title: How To Roast Garlic
ingredients: 1 head garlic (elephant garlic has many cloves & works well)
directions: preheat oven to 425 degrees f.
slice off the very top of the garlic head. place in a piece of foil and drizzle olive oil inside the head of garlic until it is completely filled and just starting to run down the side.
wrap tightly with foil and place on a cookie sheet and bake until tender and fragrant, roughly 35 minutes.
remove from the oven and let cool. peel outside off of bulb of garlic, then gently squeeze each clove out.
use in the recipe of your desire, or simply spread on bread for a wonderful addition to any meal.

title: Potato Rosemary Bread Strata With Asparagus And Gruyere
ingredients: 1/2 loaf potato rosemary bread, cut into 1-inch chunks
1 lb fresh asparagus, woody ends snapped and cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees.spray bottom and sides of a 13" x 9" x 2" glass baking dish with cooking spray. place half of the bread cubes in the bottom of the dish. bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. add asparagus and cook until just tender - about 3-4 minutes. drain and rinse under cool water.
in a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
in a small mixing bowl, combine cheeses. add chives and parsley and then gently mix.
place half of the asparagus on top of the bread cubes, then half of the cheese mixture.
then put half of the egg mixture on top.
repeat with remaining bread, asparagus, cheese mixture and egg mixture.
make sure the bread cubes are mostly submerged in the egg mixture. if not, press them down.
for best results, let mixture rest for 15 minutes before cooking so the bread can absorb the egg.
place glass baking dish on a baking sheet into the preheated oven.
bake 35-40 minutes, until browned and puffed.

title: Broccoli Salad
directions: cut broccoli tops into small florets.
in large bowl, combine broccoli, onion, raisins and bacon.
mix together mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar; pour over broccoli mixture and toss lightly to combine.
chill several hours or overnight.

title: Stir-Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. reduced calorie margarine
1/2 c. chopped red or green bell pepper
dash of black pepper to taste
directions: in 10-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine over high heat until bubbly and hot.
add celery, stirring quickly and frequently for 1 minute.
add cabbage, bell pepper and onion; continue to stir.
fry until vegetables are tender-crisp, approximately 2 to 3 minutes.
add soy sauce and pepper.
stir well and cook for 1 minute longer.
makes 4 servings.
contains only 39 calories.

title: Cheesy Tuna Linguine & Mushroom Casserole ( Tuna Noodle )
ingredients: 1 cup mushroom, rough chop (i use a medley of oyster, kikurage, shitake and champignon)
1 (10 1/2 ounce) can cream of mushroom soup
12 ounces canned albacore tuna, drain and rough chunk
1/2 cup jalapeno potato chips, crumbled (i use lay's bistro gourmet )
directions: heat oven to 350°f.
lightly oil a 13 x 9 baking dish, set aside.
saute garlic, onion and celery in olive oil till translucent, stir in mushrooms, set pan aside.
in a large microwave safe bowl combine neufchatel cheese, soup and milk, heat to warm, whisking till smooth.
add saute mixture and the next two cheeses to bowl, stirring to combine.
into the same large bowl add the linguine and tuna, add these in small increments to coat evenly. pour into prepared baking dish. top with remaining cheddar cheese and potato chips.
bake 20- 25 minutes until hot and golden. ovens vary.

title: Cherry Blintz Salad
directions: dissolve jello in boiling water.
stir in pie filling.
turn into greased shallow 3-quart dish; chill until firm.

title: Strawberry Banana Marshmallow Fondue Skewers
directions: thread 1 marshmallow, then 1 strawberry, and then 1 banana slice on each skewer.
serve immediately with hot fudge for dipping.
calories: 83
protein: 1g
carbohydrates: 21g
trace fat
trace saturated fat
cholesterol: 0mg
fiber: 1g
sodium: 17mg

title: Toffee Bars
directions: separate graham crackers into individual pieces on cookie sheet.
sprinkle chopped nuts over graham crackers.
in saucepan combine sugar, margarine and butter.
bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes.
pour over graham crackers.
bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
yields 48 bars.

title: Basil and Goat Cheese Pizza
ingredients: 1 whole batch of pizza dough (frozen, store bought or homemade), for a large size pizza
1 whole large tomato, sliced or chopped
8 ounces, weight fresh mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced
directions: set out pizza dough to bring to room temperature and allow to rise before preparing pizza.
(i usually do this at least a few hours in advance because it makes the dough much easier to work with.)
place a pizza stone in the oven and preheat to 500 degrees f. remove stone from the oven after 15-20 minutes.
roll out dough and place on top of the hot stone for pizza assembly (this allows the bottom of the crust to cook a little bit while you are making the pizza.
otherwise, the bottom crust doesnt cook as fast as the top does.)
spread tomatoes out over dough, then layer basil on top.
mozzarella should be put on top of the basil to keep it from burning.
last, sprinkle goat cheese crumbles on top to taste.
bake for 5 minutes, then rotate pizza and bake another 5 minutes.
remove pizza from oven and brush the outer crust with garlic butter.
bake another 1 minute, or until golden brown.

title: Cherry Dump Cake
directions: spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
cover with pineapple and juice.
sprinkle cake mix over fruit.
drizzle with melted oleo.
top with coconut and nuts.
bake 1 hour at 325°.
serve with cool whip, if desired.

title: Brown Sugar Raspberry Cake
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) container berry yogurt (i use mixed berry variety from ski.)
4 tablespoons light olive oil (peanut, vegetable, canola or sunflower oils may be substituted.)
directions: preheat oven to 175c (350f).
grease cake tin.
(i use the cake tin with a hole in the centre.
cooking time will need to be increased if the cake tin does not have a hole in the centre.
mix wet ingredients in a large bowl.
combine dry ingredients together in a medium bowl.
place dry ingredients into the large bowl, and stir together thoroughly.
(don't worry about being gentle with the raspberries.
the intention is for the raspberries to spread through the cake evenly.
pour the mixture into a cake tin.
bake for 30 minutes.
(a sewer inserted will not come out clean when cake is finished as this is a very moist cake.
instead, tap the surface of the cake and examine colour to determine if it is cooked.

title: Zakary Pelaccios Lobster Club Sandwich
ingredients: 4 slices pepperidge farm white bread, crusts removed
2 1 1/2-pound lobsters, parcooked and meat removed from shells
8 slices pepperidge farm white bread, lightly toasted
2 heads boston or bibb lettuce, the best inner leaves only
4 slices medium gorgeous heirloom tomato, about 1/4 inch thick
directions: put the egg yolk and garlic in the bowl of a food processor and pulse, using a rubber spatula to scrape any yolk that gets stuck to the sides of the processor back toward the blades, until smooth.
then puree, slowly adding the oil while the machine is running until the aioli has emulsified.
add the vinegar and lime juice and process to combine.
season with salt to taste and stir in the sambal.
cover and refrigerate until youre ready to use.

title: Cheesy, Spicy Hasselback Bread
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheese, such as monterey jack or cheddar
1-2 jalapenos, thinly sliced (use more or less, depending on your spice preference)
1 small red chili, thinly sliced (use more or less, depending on your spice preference)
directions: preheat the oven to 375°f.
slice bread into 1/2-inch to 1-inch slices cross-wise, without slicing all the way through. (leave about 1/4 inch intact at the bottom.)

prepare a sheet pan with one large piece of aluminum foil; you're going to wrap the bread in this after you stuff it. (you can skip this step if you don't want to use or don't have any aluminum foil, but it's recommended if you are going to stuff with lots of extras.)
place the bread on top of the aluminum foil on the baking sheet. stuff the cheese, crumbled chorizo, and sliced jalapeno and red chili in between the slices.

wrap the stuffed bread in the aluminum foil and bake until everything is really melty and the bread is getting toasty, about 10 to 15 minutes. open the aluminum foil and turn the oven to broil. return bread to the oven until the top is nice and crispy, about 3 to 5 minutes more. top with torn cilantro, if you like.

title: Vegetarian Nachos
ingredients: 1 none medium spanish onion, finely chopped
1 (15 oz) can red kidney beans in chili sauce, drained, rinsed
directions: preheat oven to 400°f.

heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. sweat onion and garlic, stirring, for 5 mins, or until onion softens. add tomatoes and kidney beans. bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 15 mins, stirring constantly, until thickened slightly.
arrange tortilla chips on a large ovenproof plate. spoon bean mixture over top then sprinkle with cheese. bake for 10 mins, or until cheese is melted. serve topped with sour cream and fresh cilantro.

title: Mincemeat-Filled Braid
directions: dissolve yeast in warm water. in a large bowl, combine next six ingredients, yeast mixture and 1-1/2 cups flour; beat on medium speed 2 minutes. stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough (dough will be sticky).
turn onto a floured surface; knead until smooth and elastic, 6-8 minutes. place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease the top. cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.
meanwhile, for filling, crumble mincemeat in a small saucepan; add water. bring to a boil. reduce heat; cook over medium-low heat until thickened, 20-25 minutes. set aside; cool.

punch down dough. turn onto a lightly floured surface; divide into thirds. roll each into a 14x4-in. rectangle. spread a third of the filling down the center of each strip; bring the sides of each strip together over filling. pinch seams to seal. place strips, seam side down, on a greased
and braid. pinch ends to seal; tuck under. cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.
preheat oven to 350°. bake until golden brown, 20-25 minutes. remove from pan to a wire rack to cool.
combine icing ingredients; drizzle over braid.

title: Homemade Bread
directions: use no salt.
mix flour and lard together until well blended. put yeast in warm water; add to flour mixture.
add sugar.
mix together until well blended.
put flour onto table.
put flour mixture onto it.
knead dough 250 times or until it snaps back. let raise 1 1/2 hours.
punch down.
let rise again for same time. put into pans.
let rise 1/2 hour.
bake at 330° for 45 minutes.

title: Eggplants upside down
directions: wash the rice and soak it in water while preparing the other ingredients
slice the onions
cut the eggplants into cubes
fry the eggplants and drain them from oil
place the onions at the bottom of a pot, put the eggplants on top, add water to only cover the ingredients
add salt and 1 tsp of cinnamon and let boil for 3 minutes
add the rice, fill the pot with water to cover the rice and cook on low fire until water evaporates.
fry almonds and/or pine nuts and spread on top of the plate for serving.
this dish is delicious with rocket salad or yogurt.

title: Three-Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 15-ounce can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 15-ounce can kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, finely chopped
directions: in a large bowl, combine the cannellini beans, chickpeas, kidney beans, celery, onion, parsley, and rosemary.
in a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper. drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and toss. serve at room temperature.

title: Super Easy Vodka Sauce
directions: heat butter and oil over medium heat. cook onion in butter and oil until transparent. add tomatoes, heavy cream, and vodka. cook on medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. serve over pasta. enjoy!

title: Farmer'S Garlic Bread
directions: melt butter.
add ingredients, stirring over heat until blended.
remove from heat and brush on italian or french bread slices.

title: Philadelphia Cheesecake Parfaits
ingredients: 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese 8 oz. each, softened
1 1/2 cups cool whip whipped topping thawed
directions: beat cream cheese, sugar, milk, lemon zest and juice in medium bowl with mixer until blended. gently stir in cool whip.

reserve about 3 tbsp. cookie crumbs. spoon 1 tbsp. of the remaining cookie crumbs into each of 10 parfait glasses; top with 2 tbsp. cream cheese mixture. cover with layers of strawberries, remaining cookie crumbs, remaining cream cheese mixture and blueberries.
sprinkle with reserved cookie crumbs.

title: Almond Roca
directions: melt butter and margarine.
add sugar and stir well.
add chopped almonds and stir until caramel color.
it will take a long time to change color.
pour onto a greased cookie sheet and spread evenly.
cool.
cover one side with melted chocolate bits and ground almonds.
cool.
may repeat on other side.
cool.
break in pieces and store in sealed container.

title: Oven Baked Tomatoes
directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f and lightly grease a round ramekin with cooking spray.
cut the top off the tomato, setting it aside, and scoop out the seeds.
lay the tomato upside down on a paper towel to drain for 5 minutes.
whisk together the remaining ingredients in a small bowl and then spoon into the hollowed-out tomato.
place the tomato in the ramekin and put the top of the tomato back on.
bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the tomato is tender.

title: Red Lentil Dal With Mint Yogurt
ingredients: 1 none green pepper, deseeded and finely diced
directions: mix the yogurt and mint together and season to taste. chill.

heat butter in a large saucepan. saute onions until translucent. add the lentils, red chili, cloves, cardamom, curry powder, cumin, cinnamon, garlic and apricots and stir to combine. add tomatoes and vegetable stock and bring to a boil. lower heat and simmer for 35-40 minutes or until lentils are soft.
stir mixture, gently mashing some of the lentils.
stir in a pinch of sugar, season to taste, and serve with flatbreads and the mint yogurt.

title: Parmesan Potato Wedges
directions: cut each potato into 8 wedges; place in a large resealable plastic bag.
add oil; seal bag and shake to coat.
in another resealable bag, combine the parmesan and seasonings.
add potatoes, a few at a time and shake to coat.
place in a single layer in a 15 by 10 inch baking pan, sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
bake, uncovered, at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown, turning once.

title: Pinwheels
directions: blend 1/2 cup butter, flour, salt and water until dough crumbles.
roll out to 1/2-inch thick, about 12-inch squares. mix together sugar and cinnamon.
brush dough with 2 tablespoons butter.
sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture over dough.
roll and wrap in wax paper.
chill about 3 hours.
slice 1/4-inch thick.
bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Spaghetti With Chanterelle Mushrooms And Ham
directions: for garlic sauce, puree egg, mustard and garlic in a blender. with the machine running, gradually stream in 1/2 cup oil then add cream. season and set aside.
cook spaghetti in boiling salted water according to package instructions. drain.

meanwhile, heat remaining oil and butter in a large frying pan and sweat onions until translucent. add mushrooms and saute over medium-high heat until tender and golden. add ham and 1/2 the chopped thyme and cook for 1-2 mins. season to taste. toss with pasta and 1/2 the garlic sauce. transfer to warmed serving plates then top with remaining garlic sauce. garnish with thyme.

title: Basil/Balsamic Vinegar Dressing Recipe
directions: combine in a jar, shake, and allow to sit, preferably overnight.
the salad will also be improved if it is dressed and allowed to sit for several hrs, that is good, since there is a lot of it!

title: White Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut in 3/4 inch cubes
1 (1/25 oz.) pkg. mccormick white chicken chili seasoning
1 (15 to 16 oz.) can white beans, undrained
directions: cook or bake the chicken until tender.
heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. add chicken; cook and stir for 5 minutes or until golden.

title: Creamy Onion Dressing
directions: 1. place onion, vinegar, agave, mustard and salt in a vita-mix and puree on high speed for 20 seconds, until smooth.
2. turn on vita-mix and drizzle in olive oil.
3. serve over your favorite greens, cooked or raw.

title: Shelly's Oklahoma Snails: Snails Menetrel / Escargots a La Menet
directions: preparation time 25 minutes.
cooking time 8 minutes.
make snail butter by working the butter with a mixture of chopped parsley, garlic, shallots and anchovy fillets.
season with the salt, pepper and spice, then work through a fine sieve.
place a piece of butter the size of a bean inside each snail shell.
add the snail, then close up the shell with some more butter, pressing it down firmly.
arrange the snails on a dish and moisten with the wine if liked.
sprinkle with the breadcrumbs and bake in a hot oven for 8 minutes.
dry white wines: macon-vire, bourgogne-aligote, rully, pouilly-fuisse.

title: Southern BBQ Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup kraft mayo with olive oil reduced fat mayonnaise
1 pkg. (12 oz.) oscar mayer selects uncured premium beef sausage, sliced
1 tbsp. grey poupon savory honey mustard
directions: combine coleslaw blend, mayo, vinegar and pepper.
cook sausage in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat 5 min.
or until evenly browned, stirring occasionally.
add barbecue sauce and mustard; cook on low heat 5 min.
or until heated through, stirring occasionally.
fill rolls with sausage mixture and coleslaw.

title: Sicilian Zucchini
directions: cut zucchini about 1/8-inch thick.
place 1 cup water in a small bowl and gradually add the flour, sifting the flour through a sieve.
continually blend the mixture with a small hand beater. continue to add flour until the batter has the consistency of sour cream.
heat vegetable oil in skillet (3/4-inch deep) over high heat.
when hot, place zucchini slices in a pan to cover the bottom.
allow slices to float.
when golden, turn them over and brown the other side.
when both sides are golden, remove from skillet with a slotted spoon; place on a plate with paper towels. sprinkle with salt and serve as soon as possible.

title: Rice Krispies Cookies
directions: melt together white chocolate and peanut butter.
add peanuts and rice krispies.
mix well but gently.
drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
let set an hour.
makes approximately 7 dozen cookies.

title: Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 1 cup fresh pineapple, cut into 1 inch pieces
directions: mix all ingredients together and serve immediately. enjoy!

title: Ancho-Orange Hot Fudge Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsweetened dutch processed cocoa powder
kosher or sea salt, to taste
directions: place butter, corn syrup, brown sugar, cocoa powder, and chocolate in a medium saucepan. cook over medium-low heat until chocolate is fully melted, stirring constantly.
stir in evaporated milk, bring to a boil, and continue to cook until sauce thickens, about 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

remove from heat and add in vanilla, chili powder, and orange extract; stir to combine. season with salt to taste. let sauce cool until warm, then serve over ice cream or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week, reheating before use.

title: Never-Fail Brownies
directions: melt chocolate and margarine.
combine sugar and eggs.
add chocolate mix to sugar mix.
stir in flour, baking powder and salt.
add nuts and chips (optional).
spread in 8-inch greased pan.
bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
frost with fudge frosting (recipe follows).

title: Coconut Orange Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb raw large shrimp, shelled and deveined
directions: combine 1/2 cup coconut, banana, hot sauce, orange juice, oil and orange peel in blender; puree.
pour mixture into large plastic resealable bag.
add shrimp and toss to coat.
refrigerate for 1 hour.
preheat oven to 450.
line 13x9 baking pan with foil.
lightly grease foil.
sprinkle remaining coconut onto waxed paper.
dip shrimp into coconut, pressing firmly on each side to coat.
place shrimp on baking pan.
bake 6 to 8 minutes or until shrimp are opaque.

title: Barbecue Baked Beans Veganized!
ingredients: 3 cups great northern beans, cooked or 3 cups pinto beans
1 tablespoon braggs liquid aminos (or soy sauce)
1 teaspoon beef style seasoning (mckay's is good)
directions: mix all ingredients together in a large ovenproof dish.
bake at 350f for 45-60 minutes.
serve hot or room temperature.
season to taste with salt and pepper.
enjoy!

title: Tallarene
directions: brown onion and beef in hot oil.
add soup, water, salt, noodles, corn and olives; mix thoroughly.
sprinkle cheese over top.
cover; cook over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes, or until noodles are tender.

title: Chocolate Caramels
directions: place all ingredients in medium saucepan.
bring to boil on low heat, stirring constantly.
cook until mixture is thickened and reaches 246f when tested with a candy thermometer, stirring constantly.
pour into lightly buttered 8x4-inch loaf pan.
(do not scrape mixture from bottom of saucepan.)
let stand until set.
score candy into 48 squares with large sharp knife.
invert candy onto cool surface; turn over so marked side is up.
cut candy into squares.
wrap each caramel in waxed paper.
let stand in cool place overnight to set.
store at room temperature.

title: Jeff'S Bordelaise Sauce
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon olive oil, or to taste
directions: melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. saute onion, carrots, celery, peppercorns, and cloves in melted butter until onions are browned, 7 to 10 minutes.

stir flour into the onion mixture; cook and stir until the flour is completely moistened, 1 to 2 minutes. stream beef broth into the skillet while stirring the onion mixture; cook, stirring continually, until the broth thickens into a gravy, 5 to 10 minutes. add water to thin the gravy as needed to keep it from becoming paste-like.

stir 1 tablespoon parsley into the gravy; continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the parsley imparts flavor to the gravy, 5 to 10 minutes; strain through a fine-mesh strainer into a clean saucepan. discard vegetables.
place the saucepan over low heat. season sauce with salt, pepper, and most of the remaining parsley. stir red wine into the sauce.

heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat; saute mushrooms in hot oil until completely tender, about 5 minutes. stir mushrooms into the sauce; garnish with remaining parsley after spooning over steaks.

title: Pan Fried Pepper Steak
ingredients: sea salt and freshly ground back pepper, to season
4 small red eschallots, peeled and sliced
3 fluid ounces chicken stock or water
1 very fresh iceberg lettuce, cut into quarters
directions: heat 2 tbs olive oil and the butter in a pan. when the butter starts to bubble,season the steaks liberally with salt and black pepper and add to pan. reduce heat to medium. turn steaks after about 4 minutes and cook a further 2 minutes on the other side, or cook to your liking. remove steaks from pan.
add the shallots and garlic to the same pan and cook until translucent. add the brandy and brined peppercorns and allow the alcohol to burn off.
add the stock, heat and maintain a simmer then return the steaks to the pan.
add the cream and allow it to melt through. finish with a squeeze of lemon.
place the iceberg lettuce quarters over 4 plates and dress with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice and sea salt.
place a piece of steak over each and finish with the sauce.

title: Professional-Tasting Homemade "Edible" Ra-yu
ingredients: 1 large whole head of garlic garlic (finely chopped)
1 to 3 red chili peppers, finely chopped
100 ml sesame oil (to be used later)
1 tsp each doubanjiang + soy sauce + sugar + salt
1 bit less than 1 onion fried onion (see
directions: chop up all the vegetables.
use the green parts of the leek too.
if you add too much red chili pepper it will be too spicy so be careful.
add all the chopped up vegetables to the vegetable oil and fry slowly over medium heat.
when it starts to change color, raise the heat to high to crisp it all up, then turn off the heat.
it will continue cooking in residual heat, so turn it off just before you think it's done.
add the sesame oil as soon as you turn off the heat.
add the ingredients to finish.
if the oil is still hot, be careful.
it works best if you have the combined before you add them to the oil.
you can keep this in the refrigerator for about 3 weeks.
sterilize the storage container with boiling water before putting the oil in it.

title: Creamy Cucumber Slices
directions: mix salt, pepper, sugar and vinegar.
add sour cream.
stir until smooth.
fold in onions, parsley and cucumber slices. arrange on flat dish.

title: Eva'S Scalloped Pineapple
directions: grease casserole.
combine all ingredients.
place in prepared casserole. bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

title: Skinny Girl Easy Mozzie Stix!
ingredients: 1 egg roll wrappers, cut in half "hotdog" style *the egg roll wrapper acts as a "safety net", to maintain form and hold the cheese in so you don't end up with a horrible mess or ugly looking snack lol.
directions: in a bowl, combine about a cup of panko, a tsp of thyme, garlic powder, & 3 tbs shredded parmesan (or however much you like).
set up a "station", consisting of your cutting board, plate lined with wax paper, knife, ingredients, bowl of bread crumbs, and pam sprayed cooking sheet.
slice up your jalapeaao & some cheese - cheese should be generous, as you want your snacks to be cheesy, right?
lay an egg roll wrapper on the wax paper plate and then place the cheese on the wrapper, add the onion powder & the jalapeaao.
use your finger to dip in the water and spread around the edges of the wrapper.
fold it burrito style.
*the wax paper is important here so that your wrappers don't stick to the plate and/or tear.
trust me, it's worth it.
next, spray the folded wrapper with some pam on all sides, and roll it in the breadcrumb mixture.
once thoroughly coated, place on baking sheet.
get creative while you're making these!
add whatever else sounds yummy!
here you can see that i also added red pepper flakes & some shredded 3-state cheddar cheese, and omitted the jalapeaao.
these are a totally versatile snack, so have fun!
once you have a tray ready for the oven, spritz the snacks one more time with the pam, a).
to hold down the panko mix, & b.)
they will brown nicely in the oven
bake on 300a for about 30 mins.
*everyone's oven cooks differently, so make sure to keep an eye on them!
you will know they are good when you can poke them with a knife and feel that they are super hot & a little bit crispy, yet the center is melted & soft.

title: Maple leaf Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 each pastry unbaked 10 inch, well chilled, fluted edge
1 x pastry leaf shapes cut from scraps
1 1/2 cups pumpkin puree, fresh or canned
directions: preheat oven to 425.
mix together pumpkin, syrup, milk and eggs.
whisk together until smooth.
stir in flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and salt.
mix until well blended.
pour pumpkin mixture into pie shell.
bake about 40 minutes until filling is firm and a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
let cool.
while cooling, place leaf shapes in oven on cookie sheet and bake until golden brown.
garnish top of pie with baked leaf shapes.
let cool completely before cutting with a sharp knife.

title: Crunchy Potato Pancakes Recipe
directions: grate potatoes on largest holes on four-sided grater (not the slicer part).
grate onion on one of the smaller holes.
add in remaining ingredients.
fry in about half inch of oil on one side till dark brown, then turn over.
keep stirring potato mix as juice and flour settles to the bottom before getting it spooned into the pan.
makes about 10 pancakes.

title: Pori Chikki
ingredients: 1 cup rice, puffed (murmura, mumra, mamra or pori)
directions: the puffed rice should be crunchy, if not, roast in 200f oven for 20 minutes.
powder puffed rice coarsely.
heat oil in fry pan.
add sugar and stir.
when it turns brown, add pori and stir well.
transfer to a greased or silicone pan/plate.
cut into pieces.
variations: peanuts, cashews, roasted edamame, pretzels, rice crackers, wasabi peas, coconut, raisins, almonds, pecans etc etc.
when cool, store in a jar.
i can be kept for 2 weeks.

title: Berry Saft
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups water, or more as needed
1 pound white sugar, or as needed
directions: bring blackberries and water to a boil in a large pot until blackberries are softened, about 15 minutes. remove from heat and mash berries using a potato masher.

line a sieve with cheese cloth; place over a large pot. pour mashed berries through cheese cloth-line sieve; let sit until all liquid has drained through cheese cloth, about 30 minutes. stir 1 pound sugar per 1/2 gallon of drained blackberry juice.
bring blackberry juice and sugar to a boil in a pot; cook until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes. skim off any residue accumulated on top.

sterilize jars and lids in boiling water for at least 5 minutes. pack hot saft into the hot, sterilized jars, filling the jars to within 1/4 inch of the top. run a knife or a thin spatula around the insides of the jars after they have been filled to remove any air bubbles. wipe the rims of the jars with a moist paper towel to remove any food residue. top with lids, and screw on rings. store in refrigerator.

title: Quick Yummy Thai Vegetarian Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes (start with less, work up to desired heat)
directions: cook noodles according to package directions, if you have none precooked.
prep veggies.
heat pan medium high.
use cooking spray.
saute carrot for a minute.
add celery, peas and garlic; give a minute.
add shrooms and onion.
once veggies are to desired doneness, transfer to a bowl.
add to veggies.
at some point before or during cooking veggies put together the sauce: peanut butter, yogurt, coconut, fish sauce, sweet n low and pepper flakes to taste.
i added a little boiling water (1/2 tablespoon?)
to make it more of a honey consistency.
add to your desired consistency.
mix all and enjoy.

title: Creamy Strawberry Milkshake
ingredients: 2 cups strawberries, husks removed safeway 1 lb for $3.99 thru 02/09
1/2 cup (1/2 of 8-oz. tub) philadelphia cream cheese spread
1 tbsp. country time strawberry lemonade drink mix
directions: blend ingredients in blender until smooth.

title: Nice and easy nasi goreng
ingredients: 6 grams spring onions, chopped into thin rings
1 chilli, chopped or use equivalent qty chilli paste
1 tsp cooking oil or low fat cooking spray
1 tsp cooking oil or low fat cooking spray
directions: heat oil or cooking spray in a wok.
add garlic.
add chilli and onion and fry until fragrant.
add beef mince, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
fry until mince is cooked through.
meanwhile fry the eggs to your liking.
add the rice and the sauce and mix through.
stir in the spring onions and then serve with the fried egg on top.

title: Ultimate Chocolate Cake
directions: melt the chocolate; allow to cool.
prepare 2 (9-inch) layer cake pans by lightly spraying with cooking spray.
place a circle of waxed paper in the bottom of each pan and lightly spray again over the waxed paper.

title: Indian Bannock
directions: mix.
add enough water to make a soft dough.
you can bake in oven, or you can deep fry it.

title: Pork And Squid Chinese Dumpling Filling
ingredients: 10 ounces squid meat (300g, can include legs)
directions: chop up the chives or cut to 1/8-1/4 inch pieces, mix in salt and set aside.

clean and chop the squid up or coarsely grind it in a food processor. do not let it become all pasty because we want to see small pieces of squid in your dumplings. ( ---- if you buy a whole squid, you have to remove the bone, mouth, eyes and the ink sack if you don't want the color.).
blend well into the squid one by one the pork, all seasonings, and the chives, until everything sticks together like a big sticky ball.
use one teaspoon of this filling for each dumpling or wonton wrapper.

title: Double Chocolate Raspberry Swirl Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup land o lakes butter, melted
32 (2-inch) (about 3 cups) crisp chocolate chip cookies, finely crushed
